name: Particle Splatting for Density Field Construction
definition: A 3D density field representing a wax surface is constructed on the CPU every frame by splatting interpolated particles into a 3D grid aligned with the container.
summary: Particle Splatting for Density Field Construction rasterizes particles into a 3D CPU grid to build density fields, differing from image-space methods by using object-space fixed grids to avoid resolution limits.
